name: 188. Plugin config round-trip keeps a lone "*" header pattern (PR #8228)
description: A lone "*" is a legitimate request_headers pattern, but restoreRedactedValue treated any all-asterisk string as the UI's redaction placeholder and substituted the stored value, so request_headers: ["*"] silently became whatever was saved before and captured nothing. The cases run in order: seed a disabled otel row with a distinct pattern, update it to ["*"], read it back, then delete the row so a rerun starts clean. The plugin is created disabled so nothing loads and no exporter is started; only the config round-trip is under test. The folder first checks that the gateway has no otel row of its own: if it does, the mutating cases skip instead of overwriting and deleting a configuration this run did not create.
